_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiled mid-Disbelief with only 12% base rate of ±2 moves; stress (skew/dvol/netflow/crowded longs) has not broken spot or funding, so the skilled call is hold the rung until a confirmed breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on phase/direction (inflow fact only), so no conflict but no joint directional conviction
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 55-62, 30d momentum stays near flat, funding pinned near zero
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G <54 with 30d momentum <~45 and stress resolving into spot breakdown, or F&G >63 with momentum sustainably >60
